subAreas.name: Collapsed Crypt Ledge
subAreas.description: A dry basalt shelf tucked behind a fallen lintel where earlier grave-robbers stashed brass lanterns and bronze coins.

subAreas.name: Sunken Peat Basin
subAreas.description: Half-drowned marble blocks circling a black sulfur pool where bitter marsh-weeds and pale stalkers gather.

subAreas.name: Glass-Sap Hollow
subAreas.description: A windless bowl of brittle white trunks dripping frozen amber sap over cracked paving.

subAreas.name: Flooded Seam Gallery
subAreas.description: A narrow adit cut into wet black slate where rusted mining skips and acid-crawlers lurk.

subAreas.name: Hollowed Pier Arch
subAreas.description: A dry stone chamber inside a cracked bridge pier littered with deserter bedrolls and gnawed bones.

subAreas.name: Sealed Salt Gallery
subAreas.description: An unplundered limestone side-vault packed knee-deep in coarse salt and iron-wired bone stacks.

encounters.label: High Road
encounters.prose: Above frozen scree, four-wagon flagstones lift across tall stone arches toward the north.

encounters.label: Timber Post
encounters.prose: Wet peat smoke and lantern-glow mark a rough timber stockade wedged beneath a snapped arch.

encounters.label: Long Steps
encounters.prose: An overgrown sheep-track climbs toward broad basalt stair-treads cut for longer strides.

encounters.label: Salt Bog
encounters.prose: Sunken plankways lead out across steaming black sulfur puddles and salt-rimed reeds.

encounters.label: Dead Orchard
encounters.prose: Low marble terrace walls enclose rows of stunted, rime-crusted trees.

encounters.label: Dry Arch
encounters.prose: Thin blue dung-smoke curls out from beneath collapsed marble porticoes dusted in salt.

encounters.label: Old Bathhouse
encounters.prose: Warm steam rises from cracked limestone stairs dropping into a sunken stone bathhouse.

encounters.label: White Timber
encounters.prose: Brittle pale trunks rattle like bone between broken colonnades to the north.

encounters.label: Brick Hills
encounters.prose: Soot-thick heat shimmers over stepped vitrified brick domes along a black slope.

encounters.label: Smelter Pit
encounters.prose: Coal smoke and slow hammer-blows echo up from sunken basalt smelting arches.

encounters.label: Bone Cellars
encounters.prose: Collapsed hillside turf reveals tiered limestone galleries packed with salt-dried bones.

encounters.label: Black Quarry
encounters.prose: Snapped bronze hoist-chains silhouette forty-foot black stone benches in the distance.

encounters.label: North Gate
encounters.prose: A frost-crusted stone bastion straddles a monumental arch overlooking pale avenues.

encounters.label: White Dome
encounters.prose: Far to the north, a collapsed marble dome inlaid with tarnished silver ribs catches pale glare.

encounters.label: Starving Wolf
encounters.prose: Dry brush snaps behind a fallen milestone as a gaunt grey wolf pads into the sleet.

encounters.label: Black Flock
encounters.prose: Bloated crows burst off a frozen mule carcass and dive screaming at your hood.

encounters.label: Slag Hound
encounters.prose: Bitter coal-smoke curls from the ditch before a cinder-jawed mastiff lunges.

encounters.label: Peddler Cart
encounters.prose: A frostbitten peddler pushing a squeaking handcart halts by your fire and unstraps an oilcloth pack.

encounters.label: Frozen Satchel
encounters.prose: Half-buried beside a milestone, a stiff leather satchel still holds dry linen wraps.

encounters.label: Windy Shelf
encounters.prose: From a windswept granite shelf you watch grey sleet sweep across broken marble arches.

encounters.label: Frozen Boot
encounters.prose: A frost-split riding boot sits wedged under a cartwheel with sharp black Onyx coins jammed inside the heel.

encounters.label: Empty Scree
encounters.prose: Only biting wind and dry frost drift across the shale; nothing stirs along the ridge.

encounters.label: Pier Arch
encounters.prose: Behind fallen masonry you spot a dry archway hollowed inside the third bridge pier.

encounters.label: Pier Cistern
encounters.prose: Broken iron rungs drop through a manhole into a stone chamber beneath the road.

encounters.label: Road Brigand
encounters.prose: A shivering levy deserter steps out from behind an overturned wain with leveled pike.

encounters.label: Orc Raiders
encounters.prose: Tusked savages scramble over the low parapet, swinging bone clubs and flint spears.

encounters.label: Hungry Wolf
encounters.prose: A rib-thin timber wolf stalks silently behind the tall lamp-standards.

encounters.label: Courier Box
encounters.prose: Wedged inside a shattered wagon axle rests a dented tin holding bitter tonic.

encounters.label: Onyx Seam
encounters.prose: Black Onyx coins lie frozen into the mortar seam beneath a fallen lamp-pole.

encounters.label: Pier Ambush
encounters.prose: A desperado and his half-starved cur spring out from greasy blanket rolls.

encounters.label: Stolen Kit
encounters.prose: Tucked inside a hollowed pier block rests a coil of brass lock-wire.

encounters.label: Root Cellar
encounters.prose: Frost-heaved stone steps reveal a slanted oak cellar hatch beneath the terrace wall.

encounters.label: Frost Boar
encounters.prose: A bristle-backed boar charges straight through dead orchard boughs, tusks snapping.

encounters.label: Pack Whipper
encounters.prose: An orc-kin driver snaps barbed iron chain across frozen turf beside dead trees.

encounters.label: Rookery
encounters.prose: Dozens of corpse-fed crows drop shrieking from gnarled frozen branches.

encounters.label: Bitter Stems
encounters.prose: Pale green stems cling alive beneath a cracked marble irrigation trough.

encounters.label: Frozen Gum
encounters.prose: Amber sap drips frozen along split apple-bark above quiet stone troughs.

encounters.label: Crypt Ledge
encounters.prose: Behind a fallen basalt lintel you spy a dry ledge lined with bronze offering bowls.

encounters.label: Undercroft
encounters.prose: Oversized stone stairs descend into cold darkness beneath the burial mound.

encounters.label: Ridge Lynx
encounters.prose: A pale tufted lynx drops noiselessly off a tall lintel stone.

encounters.label: Mad Scribe
encounters.prose: An ink-smeared wanderer lunges off the steps, shrieking and jabbing an iron spike.

encounters.label: Tomb Dead
encounters.prose: Tarnished bronze scale chimes as a seven-foot skeleton climbs out of the doorway.

encounters.label: Grave Flask
encounters.prose: Sealed in wax beside an offering niche sits a clean phial of silver-salt oil.

encounters.label: Ledge Guard
encounters.prose: Tall bronze-clad dead rise slowly from the dry crypt shelf.

encounters.label: Tomb Writ
encounters.prose: An untouched leather scroll-case holds dry parchment etched in northern notches.

encounters.label: Peat Basin
encounters.prose: Stepping stones wind through thick steam toward a sunken marble ring.

encounters.label: Sluice Vaults
encounters.prose: A brick culvert arch rises above black sulfur water, dripping steadily inside.

encounters.label: Chalk Walker
encounters.prose: Wet reeds part as a chalk-ribbed figure staggers out, chest rattling.

encounters.label: Brine Spinner
encounters.prose: An eyeless six-legged arachnid drops from a sulfur vent, acid dripping.

encounters.label: Salt Poacher
encounters.prose: A salt-crusted scavenger whips a hooked flensing blade free beside his pan.

encounters.label: Marsh Weed
encounters.prose: Tough bitter stalks grow clear of the sulfur crust on a dry hummock.

encounters.label: Basin Stalker
encounters.prose: Chalk-ribbed walkers and an acid spinner close in around the marble ring.

encounters.label: Mire Elixir
encounters.prose: Sealed beneath a marble plinth rests a clear glass bottle of veil elixir.

encounters.label: Glass Hollow
encounters.prose: Between brittle white trunks lies a windless bowl glistening with frozen sap.

encounters.label: Oil Fiend
encounters.prose: Hot grease sizzles behind a colonnade as a skinless crouchling darts toward your pack.

encounters.label: Shackled Hulk
encounters.prose: Heavy iron chains drag across frozen moss behind a hollowed deserter.

encounters.label: Orc Butcher
encounters.prose: A slate-armored orc-kin alpha smashes brittle branches apart with a slab-cleaver.

encounters.label: Amber Resin
encounters.prose: Hardened yellow sap clings thick along a frost-split white trunk.

encounters.label: Hollowed Pair
encounters.prose: Hollowed walkers circle silently beneath the frozen glass boughs.

encounters.label: Silver Silhouette
encounters.prose: Cold snaps dead-quiet as a faceless, silvered silhouette steps out without a shadow.

encounters.label: Sap Drop
encounters.prose: A clear vial of chilled sap rests intact inside a hollow stump.

encounters.label: Flue Shaft
encounters.prose: Soot-rimmed brick steps plunge down beneath a collapsed kiln dome.

encounters.label: Chain Fanatic
encounters.prose: Hot iron links whip across black slag as a blistered zealot charges.

encounters.label: Brass Tripod
encounters.prose: Sharp clockwork clicks precede a three-legged brass walker jabbing a hot spike.

encounters.label: Slag Pack
encounters.prose: Two cinder-jawed mastiffs burst out from a cooled slag-pit.

encounters.label: Slag Pitch
encounters.prose: Inside a cracked flue collar sits a stoppered pot of thick kiln pitch.

encounters.label: Seam Gallery
encounters.prose: A narrow black adit cuts straight into wet slate beneath rusted hoist beams.

encounters.label: Hoist Shaft
encounters.prose: Snapped bronze cables dangle down into a stepped vertical quarry shaft.

encounters.label: Wire Crawler
encounters.prose: Slate-black plates click loud as an arm-thick acid crawler ripples over stone.

encounters.label: Quarry Butcher
encounters.prose: A cleaver-bearing scavenger steps out of a tool-shed with raw, bleeding gums.

encounters.label: Marrow Alpha
encounters.prose: A slate-armored orc-kin butcher hefts a notched cleaver beside the skips.

encounters.label: Miner Flask
encounters.prose: Wedged inside a rusted ore skip lies a bottle of iron-sap draught.

encounters.label: Seam Crawlers
encounters.prose: Two armored wire-crawlers drop from the wet slate ceiling.

encounters.label: Hoist Wire
encounters.prose: A dry leather roll beside the adit rails holds fresh bronze lock-wire.

encounters.label: Salt Gallery
encounters.prose: Behind a rusted bone-grille lies an unplundered limestone gallery white with salt.

encounters.label: Bone Vault
encounters.prose: Salt-drifted stairs spiral deep beneath the tiered bone niches.

encounters.label: Salted Dead
encounters.prose: Dry tendons pop loud as a brine-cured corpse climbs out of an iron niche.

encounters.label: Vault Flitter
encounters.prose: A piercing shriek rattles the grilles before a dog-sized bat swoops low.

encounters.label: Flayed Horror
encounters.prose: Hooked chains rattle wetly as a lidless, skinless apostate strides through salt.

encounters.label: Salt Oil
encounters.prose: Behind dry ribs sits an unbroken glass flask of silver-salt oil.

encounters.label: Grille Guard
encounters.prose: An iron-wired skeleton clangs forward out of the salt drifts.

encounters.label: Purge Draught
encounters.prose: Tucked into a dry salt-urn rests a sealed bottle of blight purge draught.

encounters.label: Bastion Cells
encounters.prose: Hoarfrost coats narrow stone stairs dropping into locked watch-cells below the arch.

encounters.label: Frozen Sentry
encounters.prose: A frost-locked watchman marches mechanically through the arch with leveled halberd.

encounters.label: Sill Dead
encounters.prose: Blackened ice cracks off a dead traveler dragging a snapped sword across the sill.

encounters.label: Bell Golem
encounters.prose: Deep metallic booming shakes frost off the arch as a bronze bell-hulk advances.

encounters.label: Watch Kit
encounters.prose: Wedged inside a frozen sentry-box rests a bottle of amber tonic.

encounters.label: Dome Pit
encounters.prose: Frost-rimmed marble stairs spiral downward around the sunken bronze dais.

encounters.label: Silver Sleeper
encounters.prose: White dust puffs off pale marble as a voiceless, dust-coated figure raises dead-cold fists.

encounters.label: Dome Cantors
encounters.prose: Blank-eyed cantors drift from the colonnades swinging smoking bronze censers.

encounters.label: Glass Echo
encounters.prose: Air freezes dead-quiet as a faceless silvered silhouette mirrors your stance.

encounters.label: Silver Rings
encounters.prose: Three concentric silver rings lift off the frost above a cage of hollow ribs.

encounters.label: Dome Scroll
encounters.prose: Frozen inside a tarnished silver niche lies an unbroken wax-sealed writ.
